name: enrollment
description: Online course platform: courses with prerequisites and capacity, enrollment and waitlists, lesson progress, quiz grading and completion certificates.
author: test2 benchmark author (Claude subagent)

issues.description: The default prerequisites list is one shared object stored on every course created without prerequisites, so add_prerequisite on one of them adds it to all of them.
issues.fix_hint: Default to None and store a fresh list (or always copy the argument).

issues.description: The waitlist is first come first served, but pop() takes the most recent arrival instead of the student who waited longest.
issues.fix_hint: Promote queue.pop(0) (or use a deque and popleft).

issues.anchor: return any(required in done for required in course.prerequisites)
issues.description: The docstring requires every prerequisite to be completed, but any() lets a student in after completing just one of them.
Only the instructor who teaches the quiz's course may override a score, but the check accepts any instructor, so a teacher of another course can change grades.
issues.fix_hint: Also require actor.user_id to equal the course's instructor_id and raise PermissionError otherwise.

issues.description: The quiz pass mark is owned by quizzes (PASS_PERCENT and is_passing) but certificates re-implements it with a literal 70, so changing the pass mark would leave certificates on the old rule.

build_transcript is a 60-line function that decides course status, formats waitlist, lesson and quiz lines and keeps running totals in one body; per-course and per-quiz helpers would make it readable.
The private helper _percent_of_lessons is never called; ProgressTracker.percent_complete computes progress itself.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: The broad except only logs the failure and re-raises it, so nothing is swallowed and the completion is not recorded.
The student id is reduced to [A-Za-z0-9_-] before it is joined, and the resolved path is checked to stay inside the directory.
